description: Free, read-only, needs a key. action list (default) returns only YOUR saved presets, not the 34 built-in ones: to browse built-in, community and your presets together use get_catalog kind presets (an empty list here just means you saved none). type custom (full caption styles from manage_preset, ids custom:cp_...) or brand (font, color, position and logo overlays); paginated with limit and cursor, response_format concise (default) or detailed. action get: any one preset with its full style by id, built-in (e.g. builtin:number-punch or number-punch), community or custom:cp_..., the same style JSON the web editor loads (use it as basePreset or copy and tweak it with manage_preset). action validate: check a style document (style, or basePreset + overrides) against the renderer schema before saving; returns valid, the normalized style or errors [{path, message}]. Built-in and community presets are listed by get_catalog kind presets.

action.description: list (default), get (needs id) or validate (style, or basePreset + overrides).

basePreset.description: Validate basePreset + overrides instead of a full style (custom:cp_... bases need a key).

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

id.description: Preset id: cp_... or custom:cp_... as returned by manage_preset {action:'create', type:'custom'} / get_presets {type:'custom'}.

limit.description: Page size for the returned list, 1-100. Default 50.

overrides.description: Fields deep-merged on top of basePreset before validating.

response_format.description: concise (default): short list items without nested style/example objects, to save tokens. detailed: full objects.

style.description: Full caption style document to validate.

type.description: For list: custom (default) or brand presets.

name: get_presets

hasMore.description: true when more items are available (paginated lists).

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page (paginated lists).

result.description: The value, when the tool returns something other than an object.

title: Read your saved presets
